newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Further weakness in boxed beef and expected decline in fed cattle prices.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady. Index at new two-year high but futures look overbought and corn seen rising.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.200 to off 0.100 cent. Technically weak but cash hogs seen steady to up and loins remain firm.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.250 to 0.750 cent. Product weak, out-of-town bearish and technically weak.
